text:
Your biggest enemy isn't your game. It's your mirror.

She doesn't hear your words first. She sees you first.

That's not shallow. That's biology. She needs to find you acceptable before anything else you do matters.

Height and bone structure? Not your call. But your body, your clothes, your posture? Completely yours.

Neglecting what you can control isn't humility. It's a choice to lose before you start.

Build the body. The words work after.
caption:
Self improvement and discipline mean nothing if you skip the foundation. Men fail before they start.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
